text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system appears to interpret past interactions as continuing interest in related products, functions, artists, and themes.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they preserve a specific appealing quality, such as vocal harmonies, melodic heaviness, crime narratives, or relaxed blues.",
    "Practical recommendations align when they complement an established activity or add a useful capability to equipment already owned."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "The system repeatedly recommends broadly related items without establishing the current task, equipment compatibility, or scale that would make them useful.",
    "Similar devices and tools remain prominent even when prior purchases have already satisfied the same need.",
    "Older or occasional interests compete with more recent preferences, especially for seasonal music and changing listening moods."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Broad workshop, electronics, artist, and genre similarity substitutes for a specific reason to choose an item.",
    "Shared brands, product functions, compilation formats, and holiday themes appear to imply stronger continuing demand than users express."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Exact compatibility, appropriate quantity and capacity, and the distinction between complementary purchases and redundant replacements are insufficiently reflected.",
    "Recent intent, occasion, and the particular qualities connecting past choices to a candidate receive too little weight.",
    "Tentative interest in several related items does not imply equal willingness to choose them; users consistently prioritize the strongest specific match."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Broadly plausible similarities occupy top positions without enough attention to whether each item addresses a current, compatible, unsatisfied need or a specific present preference.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "Track how often top-ranked recommendations receive a concrete choice rationale tied to recent behavior, separately from tentative interest and inability to assess relevance.",
    "Track rejection reasons involving duplicate capabilities, incompatible specifications, excessive scale, and absent current tasks.",
    "Track whether users prefer lower-ranked candidates with specific recent-interest connections over higher-ranked candidates sharing only broad themes."
  ]
}
